sentences.text: To that, Ms. Patanjali Mishra, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and Shri Abhishek Mayank, learned counsel for the informant have no objection to the aforesaid prayer.
4. Here, we may note, the present appellant is none other than the first informant who had turned hostile at the trial and had not supported the prosecution story as to the occurrence.
5. In view of the above, the prayer made by learned counsel for the appellant is granted.
The appeal preferred at the instance of the first informant is dismissed as withdrawn.
